patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections, often with a central, constrained content column, but frequently breaks out with full-bleed background colors or large product UI elements that span the width.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles, smaller but still prominent subheadings, and legible body text, all using a single font family.

The site primarily uses a dark background with light text, punctuated by a vibrant green for primary calls to action and a soft blue for the hero section, with various pastel colors appearing within the product UI elements.

As the user scrolls, the top navigation bar transforms from transparent to a solid white background with a subtle shadow, while the hero section's background image parallaxes, moving slower than the foreground content. Subsequent content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
Product UI elements, such as individual 'notes' or app screenshots, are frequently integrated as visual anchors or background textures within content sections, rather than just static images.

technique_notes: The sticky navigation bar transitions its background color and height on scroll, providing a compact and persistent header. The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect where the background image moves at a different rate than the foreground content, creating depth. Content sections are revealed using CSS keyframe animations that trigger a subtle fade-in and vertical translation as they scroll into view, enhancing engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by clear, readable body text and distinct subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements, cards, and product UI screenshots, contributing to a soft and approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing with generous vertical padding between sections and within content blocks, creating an airy and uncluttered feel, especially in the hero area.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its seamless integration of the product's actual UI elements and 'notes' as core design components throughout the page. These elements are not just static images but are used dynamically to structure content, provide visual interest, and give a tangible sense of the product's aesthetic and functionality directly within the marketing experience.
